versions.changelog:
Initial release of Email Writer Assistant.

- Generates well-formatted, professional emails based on user-specified purpose, audience, and content points.
- Adapts tone and structure to various scenarios (business, job application, client communication, internal, thanks/apology, English email).
- Includes clear subject lines with urgency/action indicators when appropriate.
- Outlines greetings, main content, clear closing actions, and signature handling.
- Automatically explains attachments in the email body if provided.
- Uses a structured markdown template for consistent output.
